input.summary: The owner asks whether overlapping flow-completion-time ranges and p=0.6 allow labelling the paper claim "disproven." Per the active server decision policy (descriptive-only, model_authored=false), no such label is authorized. Distribution overlap and failure to reject a null do not establish no effect or equivalence. Separately, the packet fields needed to propose a pilot remain unresolved.
clarification_questions: The packet's conditions, controls, inputs, design, metrics and limitations fields are all empty — can you supply the intended bottleneck bandwidth, transfer size, and any other fixed emulation parameters so a protocol can be specified?
The 20 ms delay placement is unresolved: is the 20 ms applied one-way (sender→receiver) or as a round-trip (both directions), and which netem script/topology will be used?
What is the source of the p=0.6 result you mention — was a prior emulation run already completed, and if so, should this pilot reuse that protocol or define a new independent one?
